chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 438: The Forest of Vines - The Shaoyin Clan's Ultimate Ambush
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning and Mu Northson are trapped by the Shaoyin clan's four Celestial Immortals in a devastating ambush. Witness the power of Ancestor Bitterwood's ancient spellcraft!
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 438: A Deadly Garden
og_description: The Shaoyin Clan springs its trap! Ji Ning and Mu Northson face two ancient Celestial Immortals with bizarre, overwhelming power.
twitter_description: Ji Ning and an injured ally are trapped by a forest of vines and a starry formation. The Shaoyin Clan has arrived.

lore_anchors.definition: An ancient Celestial Immortal of the Shaoyin clan, known as an anomaly for mastering powerful spell techniques instead of using magic treasures. His signature ability summons a 'forest' of devastating vines.
A powerful wind-and-lightning attack unleashed by the Winged Immortal Puppet, capable of matching the strength of a Celestial Immortal.
Ji Ning's current ultimate offensive technique, transforming the sword-light of hundreds of flying swords into a single, devastating black dragon.
A second, independent body cultivated by a Ki Refiner, sharing the same soul and consciousness. It allows a cultivator to double their combat power and tactical options in battle.
A soul-bound token used by allied cultivators to signal for help in an emergency. Destroying the talisman alerts the allies to the holder's location and danger.
A Pure Yang-ranked magic treasure capable of scrying on any location within a certain area, allowing its owner to spy on distant events.
A supreme-grade Pure Yang magic treasure owned by the Shaoyin clan, implying the clan is deploying its absolute heaviest firepower to guarantee Ji Ning's death.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Ji Ning's Primaltwin suddenly appear?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A Ki Refiner can separate their soul to create a second independent body (Primaltwin) at the Primal stage. In a desperate fight, Ji Ning released it to double his offensive power.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How do the messenger talismans work?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Allied groups leave each other linked messenger talismans. Destroying one’s own talisman immediately alerts the linked allies to the wielder's location and gives a general sense of their danger.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Who is the mysterious girl watching the fight?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She is a powerful observer, likely a high-ranking member of the Xia Emperor's court or a major faction, using the Omniscient Earth Mirror to spy on the battle.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Are the Shaoyin clan the primary villains now?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They are the most immediate and direct threat. They have committed their absolute top forces (four Celestial Immortals, Divine Bell) to kill Ji Ning, marking a critical escalation in the conflict.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a Pure Yang treasure?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is the highest grade of magic treasure, surpassing even Immortal-ranked treasures. A Pure Yang treasure like the Divine Bell is a legendary artifact of immense power, making its deployment a sign of ultimate seriousness.
